MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
